desc: Parse input: read K, S, T from stdin (as bytes); quick length check |N−M| > K → No.
Choose algorithm: Myers furthest-reaching diagonal DP, O(K²) cells, instead of O((N+M)·K) banded DP.
Design LCP acceleration: 64-bit rolling hash prefix arrays + binary search.
Verify recurrence directions and candidate guards by hand-tracing Samples 1 and 2.
Complete the truncated code: extension step using lcp(best, best+d), store into cur, per-row target check, final No after loop.
Final review: edge cases (S==T, length-1 strings, K≥needed, NEG sentinel vs valid 0), hash precompute cost O(N+M), confirm output format exactly "Yes"/"No".
